how-28-01-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the tube, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-28-01-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the tube, then tap three things you notice.

how-28-01-compare.page: Put the thermometer under one tray and the dark box under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.
how-28-01-compare.say: Put the thermometer under one tray and the dark box under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.

how-28-01-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing step: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.
how-28-01-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing step: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.

how-28-01-det.page: Pick 3 files, one at a time. Tap a clue, then name the energy that comes out. Predict the energy that goes in, and watch the place appear.
how-28-01-det.say: Pick three files, one at a time. Tap a clue, then name the energy that comes out. Predict the energy that goes in, and watch the place appear.

how-28-01-partc.page: Draw a scene from your home or school that shows at least three forms of energy in action. Label each form of energy and draw arrows showing any energy changes.
how-28-01-partc.say: Draw a scene from your home or school that shows at least three forms of energy in action. Label each form of energy and draw arrows showing any energy changes.
